description: Source code for Cypress test management integration with Zephyr Scale, including functions to create test cycles, save test executions, and handle API interactions.

methods.name: getStepStateResult
methods.description: Calculates the count of test steps by their state.

methods.name: getStepStateSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary string of step states.

methods.name: getTM4JTestCases
methods.description: Extracts and groups test cases from report results based on test case IDs.

methods.name: saveToEndpoint
methods.description: Sends data to a specified API endpoint with authorization.

methods.name: createTestCycle
methods.description: Creates a new test cycle in Zephyr Scale.

methods.name: createTestExecutions
methods.description: Creates test execution entries in Zephyr Scale for each test case.

methods.name: saveTestExecution
methods.description: Saves individual test execution data, with retry logic on failure.
